note: The source exports `async function main(input, api)` per contract. All state I/O goes through api.state.readJson/writeJson/appendJsonl/readText. Timestamps use api.nowIso exclusively (no Date.now/new Date). True temp+rename atomicity is delegated to the platform's writeJson implementation since no rename primitive is exposed in the api surface; the write order is designed so that directions_tried.json is committed before progress.json, and pivot_plan.json is cleared last — minimizing the window of partial state on crash. Missing required inputs or any thrown exception returns label 'error' with a descriptive note; full success returns label 'written'.
